decisions.statement: Whether the file at a path holds words kept as they were said is answered here.
The property whose file that is says so, rather than the file's own name.
A property naming its file is read where a page carrying it sits in that folder.
A property whose entries sit beside a page is read from the section it names.
Which sections those are is worked out once for one face.
A face that will not answer holds no words kept that way rather than refusing.
Words a page states inside its own file are answered for nowhere here.

definition: the files whose words are kept as they were said
